Pinned tesseract.js-core 7.0.0 (the WASM Tesseract.js 7.0.0 loads).

LSTM + WASM SIMD only — every browser GifOS still supports has SIMD, and
OSD/legacy detection is not shipped (that needs the larger non-LSTM core).

Rebuild these two files with:  node apps/tesseract/vendor.mjs

Language data is NOT in this directory. English rides an optional gifos.assets
pin (LANG-PINS.json / manifest.json) so the GIF stays small.
